findings.statement: The largest sleeve, high tech, remains in warning for a continuing breach and its weight edged up slightly from the prior day, so the book moved a little closer to the hard limit. It also carries a variance share far above its weight, so it does more risk work than its size suggests.
The days needed to liquidate the slowest sleeve are still above the warning level and ticked up from the prior day, a continuing warning that is well short of the hard limit.

The data quality check flagged an extreme one-day move in the telecom sleeve that peers do not share and beta does not explain, so it was treated as a likely bad tick and zeroed provisionally pending human review. The backtest is in the green zone with no exceptions, and the small VaR change came from position moves rather than the market data window.
